name: Musée Ethnographique et d'Histoire des Peuples de la Forêt d'Afrique Centrale
description: It presents the traditions, crafts, and lifestyles of forest communities such as the Baka, Beti, and Maka through ritual objects and reconstructions.
bonASavoir: At the Musée Ethnographique des Peuples de la Fôret in Yaoundé, admission costs 10,000 XAF for foreign visitors and 5,000 XAF for national citizens/residents
